products.name: Water Utility Services
products.description: Provision of water supply, including purchase, production, distribution, and sale of water to residential and commercial customers in California, requiring regulated infrastructure and compliance with environmental and safety standards.

products.name: Wastewater Utility Services
products.description: Provision of wastewater collection and treatment services to customers in certain areas of California and at U.S. military installations, involving regulated infrastructure and environmental compliance.

products.name: Electric Utility Services
products.description: Distribution and sale of electricity to residential and commercial customers in San Bernardino County mountain communities, requiring regulated infrastructure, grid management, and compliance with safety and environmental regulations.

products.name: Contracted Utility Services for Military Installations
products.description: Operation, maintenance, and construction of water and wastewater systems at U.S. military bases under long-term contracts, including renewal, replacement, and compliance with federal standards.

products.name: Renewable Energy Generation and Procurement
products.description: Development, procurement, and distribution of renewable energy (primarily solar) for electric utility customers, including utility-owned solar facilities and customer distributed generation programs.

products.name: Icovamenib (Oral Menin Inhibitor)
products.description: An orally bioavailable, selective, covalent small molecule inhibitor of menin, developed through synthetic chemistry and administered as a short-course oral therapy. It is designed to restore beta cell mass and function, improve glycemic control, and potentially provide lasting metabolic benefits for patients with type 1 and type 2 diabetes, as well as obesity. Manufactured via synthetic processes and delivered as an oral drug.

products.name: BMF-650 (Oral GLP-1 Receptor Agonist)
products.description: An investigational, next-generation, oral, small molecule GLP-1 receptor agonist developed for the treatment of obesity. Produced via synthetic chemistry, BMF-650 is designed to improve glucose control, stimulate insulin secretion, suppress appetite, and promote weight loss, with a focus on enhanced oral bioavailability and pharmacokinetic properties. Delivered as an oral medication.

products.name: Embedded IoT Solutions
products.description: Embedded IoT Solutions consist of compute modules (SoM, SiP) and wired/wireless connectivity products that are physically integrated into customer devices, enabling edge processing, AI, computer vision, and real-time analytics. These are manufactured using semiconductor technology and are typically sold to OEMs for integration into industrial, transportation, and smart city applications.

products.name: IoT System Solutions
products.description: IoT System Solutions are standalone hardware systems providing routing, switching, gateway, telematics, media conversion, PoE, and remote management functionalities. These are manufactured hardware products, often pre-certified, that deliver secure connectivity, power, and network management for distributed IoT deployments, including smart tracking and industrial IoT devices.

products.name: Out-of-Band (OOB) Management Solutions
products.description: OOB Management Solutions include advanced console management, power management, and IPKVM hardware and software products that enable secure, remote access and control of IT and networking infrastructure. These solutions are delivered as physical devices and software, supporting remote monitoring, automation, and resiliency for enterprise and data center environments.

products.name: IoT Device Management Software Platform
products.description: A Software as a Service (SaaS) platform providing centralized, cloud-based management, monitoring, automation, and OTA updates for OOB and IoT deployments. Delivered digitally, it enables customers to manage global device fleets remotely, reducing the need for on-site personnel and supporting multitenancy for OEMs and system integrators.

products.name: Engineering and Design Services
products.description: Custom engineering and design services for IoT and embedded solutions, including hardware, software, mechanical engineering, rapid prototyping, and quality assurance. Delivered by in-house engineering teams, these services accelerate product development for OEMs and system integrators, supporting complex applications such as AI, computer vision, and edge computing.

products.name: Insurance Claims Management SaaS Solutions
products.description: Cloud-based software suite for insurers to digitize and automate end-to-end P&C insurance workflows, including claims intake, documentation, photo capture, repair scheduling, communications, and network integrations. Delivered as SaaS, integrates with legacy and modern systems, and leverages AI for automation and decision support.

products.name: Automotive Repair Facility Management Solutions
products.description: Integrated cloud-based software for collision repair facilities to manage the entire repair cycle, including estimating, workflow management, scheduling, diagnostics, parts ordering, customer engagement, and payment processing. Delivered as SaaS, connects repairers with insurers, parts suppliers, and OEMs.

products.name: Automotive Repair Estimating Solutions
products.description: AI-powered estimating software for both insurers and repairers to generate detailed, accurate repair estimates using proprietary databases, machine learning, and digital workflows. Enables virtual inspections, integrates with mobile apps, and connects to real-time parts and labor data.

products.name: Total Loss Valuation Solutions
products.description: Digital solutions for insurers to identify, value, and resolve total loss automotive claims, providing market-driven vehicle valuations and automated fee calculations. Delivered via cloud platform and integrated into claims workflows.

products.name: Subrogation Automation Solutions
products.description: AI- and NLP-powered software for automating subrogation workflows between insurance carriers, including opportunity identification, demand package creation, and settlement for automotive, property, and workers’ compensation claims. Delivered as SaaS and integrated with claims data.

products.name: Casualty and Bodily Injury Claims Solutions
products.description: Software and AI tools for insurers to process, analyze, and manage casualty and bodily injury claims, including medical bill processing, negotiation, and AI-powered medical data synthesis for auto, disability, and workers’ compensation lines. Delivered as SaaS with analytics dashboards.

products.name: Disability and Workers’ Compensation Claims Guidance Solutions
products.description: AI-driven claims guidance platform (via EvolutionIQ) for disability and workers’ compensation insurers, providing real-time recommendations and workflow automation to claims examiners and adjusters. Integrates structured and unstructured data to optimize claim outcomes and return-to-work rates.

products.name: Parts Marketplace and Inventory Solutions
products.description: Digital platform for automotive parts suppliers, dealers, and recyclers to list, promote, and sell inventory in real-time to repairers and insurers. Automates order processing, invoicing, and settlement, and integrates with repair estimating workflows.

products.name: Automotive Manufacturer Network and Certification Solutions
products.description: Cloud-based solutions for automotive OEMs to manage certified repair networks, integrate telematics and repair data, administer shop audits, and facilitate collaboration with repairers and insurers. Includes tools for repair certification and reporting.

products.name: Diagnostics Service Provider Integration Solutions
products.description: Platform for diagnostics, calibration, and programming service providers to connect with repair facilities, enabling digital capture, documentation, and sharing of scan and calibration results within repair workflows.

products.name: Enterprise Payments Solutions for Insurance Economy
products.description: Integrated electronic payments platform for insurers, repairers, and other ecosystem participants to process outbound and inbound payments digitally, reducing administrative costs and cycle time. Delivered as a SaaS module integrated into existing CCC applications.

products.name: International Insurance Claims Software Solutions
products.description: Tailored insurance claims management software for international markets (notably China), including workflow, estimating, audit, and analytics modules. Delivered as SaaS and adapted for local regulatory and market requirements.

products.name: Bitcoin Mining
products.description: Operation of high-efficiency computing hardware at owned and operated sites to mine Bitcoin and validate transactions on the Bitcoin network. This involves physical infrastructure, specialized mining machines, and significant energy usage.

products.name: Bitcoin Treasury Management
products.description: Acquisition, holding, and selective sale or leveraging of Bitcoin as a corporate treasury asset, including raising capital to purchase Bitcoin and managing holdings for operational and strategic purposes. This is a financial asset management activity, not a physical product or service.

products.name: Specialty Finance for Community Associations
products.description: Provision of customized funding and financial products to nonprofit community associations, primarily in Florida, including purchasing rights to delinquent receivables and offering programs that guarantee payment of association dues. This involves financial capital and legal servicing arrangements.

products.name: Life Science Research Products
products.description: Instruments, systems, reagents, and consumables used to separate, purify, characterize, and quantify biological materials such as cells, proteins, and nucleic acids, primarily for research and biopharmaceutical laboratory environments. These products are physically manufactured and distributed globally to research institutions and industry laboratories.

products.name: Clinical Diagnostic Test Systems and Consumables
products.description: Integrated diagnostic test systems, including instruments, reagents, test kits, and specialized quality controls, provided to clinical laboratories for in vitro diagnostics. These are manufactured physical products, often delivered as standardized platforms with recurring sales of consumables and test kits.

products.name: Informatics Solutions for Clinical Laboratories
products.description: Software and informatics solutions integrated with diagnostic test systems to support standardized laboratory workflows and reproducible test results. These are digital products delivered alongside physical diagnostic platforms to clinical laboratory customers.

products.name: Oncology Therapeutics
products.description: A portfolio of small-molecule and antibody-based drugs developed for the treatment of various cancers, including clear cell renal cell carcinoma, pancreatic cancer, and non-small cell lung cancer. These therapeutics are produced using advanced drug discovery and clinical development processes, and are delivered as oral or intravenous medications, often in combination with standard-of-care chemotherapies or other immunotherapies.

products.name: Inflammation and Autoimmune Disease Therapeutics
products.description: Oral, small-molecule drugs targeting key pathways in inflammation and autoimmune diseases, designed to displace injectable biologics. These are developed through proprietary discovery platforms and are intended for conditions such as chronic urticaria and atopic dermatitis.

products.name: FANING Interactive Fandom Platform
products.description: A digital platform (mobile and PC) providing community forums, clubs, direct messaging, live chat with real-time translation, and user engagement tools for global fans of Korean culture. Delivered as a cloud-based, technology-driven service accessible worldwide.

products.name: Digital Content Marketplace (User-Generated and Company-Created)
products.description: A marketplace within FANING for buying and selling digital content such as fanart, web novels, webtoons, original shows, and web series, created by both users and the company. Content is distributed digitally and monetized via in-platform currency (FP) or cash.

products.name: Virtual Events and Concert Streaming
products.description: Hosting and streaming of live and virtual concerts, fan events, and shows, accessible globally via the FANING platform. Tickets and access are sold digitally, with options for both in-person and online participation.

products.name: FANING Fanshop (E-Commerce for Fandom Goods)
products.description: An integrated e-commerce service within FANING offering K-Culture merchandise, concert tickets, gifts, pre-paid cards, and other fandom goods. Includes both company-to-user and user-to-user transactions, with payment via FP or cash and global shipping options.

products.name: User-to-User Digital Goods Marketplace
products.description: A peer-to-peer marketplace within FANING for users to create, buy, and sell digital goods such as emojis, AR filters, and digital stickers. Transactions are settled in FP or cash, with the platform charging transaction fees.

products.name: Epic eCommerce Platform (B2B/B2C Marketplace and Logistics)
products.description: A global e-commerce and logistics platform enabling companies and entrepreneurs to sell inventory to FANING users, with integrated order management, cross-border shipping, customs clearance, and fulfillment services. Delivered as a digital marketplace with logistics support.

products.name: Advertising Services on FANING Platform
products.description: Digital advertising solutions for brands and partners, including banner ads, splash ads, pop-ups, in-platform promotions, and branded content, sold directly to advertisers and integrated into the FANING user experience.

products.name: Premium Subscription Services
products.description: Paid subscription offerings for individual users and institutional partners, providing enhanced features or exclusive content within the FANING platform. Delivered digitally via recurring payments.

products.name: Translation Matching Services
products.description: A service within FANING enabling users to offer and purchase translation of digital content (e.g., web novels, webtoons) for a commission, with revenue split between creators and translators. Delivered digitally within the platform.

products.name: Koreavibe.net Digital Media Property
products.description: A digital media website providing original news content and features dedicated to global K-culture fandoms, complementing the FANING platform and driving user engagement.

products.name: Beef Products
products.description: Processing live fed cattle into primal and sub-primal meat cuts, case-ready beef, and fully-cooked beef products, including specialty items such as hides and variety meats. Production requires large-scale physical manufacturing, regulated facilities, and logistics infrastructure.

products.name: Pork Products
products.description: Processing live market hogs into primal and sub-primal pork cuts, case-ready pork, and fully-cooked pork products, including specialty items. Production involves physical manufacturing, regulated processing, and supply chain logistics.

products.name: Chicken Products
products.description: Vertically-integrated operations raising and processing live chickens into fresh, frozen, and value-added chicken products, including breaded and fully-cooked items. Production requires breeding, farming, processing, and logistics infrastructure.

products.name: Prepared Foods
products.description: Manufacturing and marketing a wide range of frozen and refrigerated ready-to-cook and ready-to-eat food products, including sandwiches, processed meats, appetizers, snacks, and side dishes. Production is based on large-scale food processing, packaging, and distribution systems.

products.name: Chicken Breeding Stock
products.description: Supplying poultry breeding stock globally through subsidiary Cobb-Vantress, involving research, breeding, and distribution of genetic stock to poultry producers. This is a specialized agricultural and genetics business line.

products.name: Animal and Pet Food Ingredients
products.description: Production and sale of animal and pet food ingredients derived from specialty products and by-products of meat processing operations. This involves rendering and further processing of animal materials for external customers.

products.name: Outpatient Mental Health Services
products.description: Comprehensive outpatient mental health care delivered by licensed clinicians, including psychiatric evaluations and treatment, psychological and neuropsychological testing, and individual, family, and group therapy. Services are provided both virtually via a digital platform and in-person at physical centers, leveraging a hybrid care delivery model.

products.name: Integrated Behavioral and Physical Health Programs
products.description: Collaborative care programs integrating mental and physical healthcare, often in partnership with primary care and specialist physicians, including co-location of clinicians and virtual integration to improve diagnosis and treatment of patients with co-occurring conditions. Delivered through partnerships and integrated care models.

products.name: Management Services for Supported Practices
products.description: Provision of non-clinical management services to supported practices, including administrative support, billing, marketing, payor contracting, and operational management, pursuant to long-term management services contracts. These services enable supported practices to focus on clinical care while LifeStance manages business operations.

products.name: Hospital Services
products.description: Comprehensive 24/7 healthcare services delivered through a network of micro-hospitals, specialty hospitals, and hospital outpatient departments, including emergency room care, inpatient care, behavioral health, onsite imaging, laboratory, and pharmacy services. These services require physical facilities, licensed medical staff, and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Population Health Management Services
products.description: Management and operation of provider networks such as independent physician associations (IPAs), including administrative, management, and support services to affiliated hospitals and physician groups. Delivered via a Management Services Organization (MSO) and involves digital and in-person coordination, contracting, and risk-bearing arrangements.

products.name: Real Estate Leasing for Healthcare Facilities
products.description: Ownership and leasing of land and hospital buildings to hospital entities, including the design, construction, and management of healthcare-specific real estate. Involves physical property development and regulated leasing arrangements.

products.name: Drilling and Evaluation Services
products.description: Comprehensive suite of services and equipment for early well planning, drilling, and reservoir evaluation, including managed pressure drilling, directional drilling, wireline logging, and drilling fluids. Delivered through physical tools, advanced sensors, and expert engineering, often requiring on-site human labor and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Well Construction and Completion Services
products.description: Products and services for constructing and completing wells, ensuring well integrity and optimal production. Includes tubular running, cementation, liner hangers, completion tools, and related engineering, delivered via specialized equipment, software-enabled design, and field services.

products.name: Production and Intervention Services
products.description: Technologies and services to enhance, maintain, and responsibly abandon oil and gas wells, including intervention services, artificial lift, sub-sea intervention, and pressure pumping. Delivered through engineered tools, field operations, and specialized equipment for both onshore and offshore environments.

products.name: Artificial Lift Systems
products.description: Pressure-enabling systems and automation to extract reservoir fluids from wells lacking natural flow, including rod lift, gas-lift, hydraulic-lift, plunger-lift, and hybrid systems. Requires physical manufacturing, installation, and digital control systems.

products.name: Digital Solutions for Drilling and Production
products.description: Software, automation, and flow measurement solutions for real-time data aggregation, engineering, and optimization of drilling and production operations. Delivered digitally, integrating workflows and analytics for well and surface facility management.

products.name: Pressure Pumping and Reservoir Stimulation Services
products.description: Advanced fluid chemistry products and pumping services for production enhancement, including acidizing, fracturing, cementing, and coiled-tubing intervention. Delivered through engineered fluids and specialized pumping equipment, primarily in select international markets.

products.name: Multiple Sclerosis (MS) Therapies
products.description: A portfolio of biologic and small molecule drugs (e.g., TYSABRI, TECFIDERA, VUMERITY, AVONEX, PLEGRIDY) developed, manufactured, and marketed for the treatment of multiple sclerosis. These products require advanced biologics manufacturing, regulatory approvals, and global distribution.

products.name: Alzheimer's Disease Therapies
products.description: Co-developed and co-commercialized therapies for Alzheimer's disease, primarily LEQEMBI, an anti-amyloid antibody, delivered via IV or subcutaneous injection. Requires biologics manufacturing, clinical development, and global regulatory approvals.

products.name: Rare Disease Therapies
products.description: A suite of therapies for rare neurological diseases, including SPINRAZA for spinal muscular atrophy (SMA), SKYCLARYS for Friedreich’s ataxia (FA), and QALSODY for SOD1 ALS. These are advanced biologics or antisense oligonucleotides, requiring specialized manufacturing and regulatory pathways.

products.name: Neuropsychiatry Therapies
products.description: Therapies for neuropsychiatric conditions, notably ZURZUVAE for postpartum depression (PPD), developed and commercialized in partnership. Delivered as small molecule drugs, requiring clinical development and regulatory approval.

products.name: Anti-CD20 and Related Immunology Therapies
products.description: Business and financial rights to a portfolio of anti-CD20 monoclonal antibody therapies (e.g., RITUXAN, RITUXAN HYCELA, GAZYVA, OCREVUS, LUNSUMIO, COLUMVI) for oncology and autoimmune indications, commercialized via collaboration and licensing agreements. These are biologics requiring complex manufacturing and distribution.

products.name: Biosimilars of Advanced Biologics
products.description: Commercialization of biosimilars referencing leading biologic drugs (e.g., BENEPALI, IMRALDI, FLIXABI) for autoimmune and inflammatory diseases. These are manufactured via advanced biologics processes and distributed in select international markets.

products.name: Digital Banking Platform
products.description: A unified, cloud-based SaaS platform providing end-to-end digital banking functionality for retail, SMB, and commercial banking, including onboarding, account management, payments, integrations, risk and fraud management, and personal financial management tools. Delivered via a scalable, configurable, and highly secure digital interface integrated with core and third-party systems.

products.name: Risk and Fraud Solutions
products.description: A suite of advanced analytics and machine learning-based solutions for fraud detection, risk assessment, dispute management, fraud alerts, and regulatory compliance, offered both as embedded features within the digital banking platform and as standalone SaaS products to financial institutions and FinTechs.

products.name: Digital Lending and Relationship Pricing Solutions
products.description: Cloud-based solutions supporting digital lending workflows, borrower onboarding, origination, underwriting, servicing, collections, and relationship pricing for both commercial and consumer loans, including data-driven sales enablement and actionable insights. Delivered as SaaS and integrated with customer systems.

products.name: Helix (Core Processing and Banking-as-a-Service Platform)
products.description: A cloud-native core processing and Banking-as-a-Service (BaaS) platform enabling financial institutions and FinTechs to incorporate banking products and services into digital offerings, providing core banking functionality, compliance frameworks, and integration capabilities for regulated banking activities. Delivered as a SaaS or usage-based service.

products.name: Q2 Innovation Studio (Open Platform and Developer Ecosystem)
products.description: An API and SDK-based open technology platform that enables customers and third-party developers to extend, customize, and integrate new functionality into the Q2 digital banking platform, supporting rapid innovation and deployment of new digital financial services within a regulated environment.

products.name: Medicare Advantage Plans
products.description: Clover Health offers Medicare Advantage (MA) insurance plans, including Preferred Provider Organization (PPO) and Health Maintenance Organization (HMO) plans, which provide healthcare coverage to Medicare-eligible individuals. These plans are managed and delivered through wide physician networks and are supported by proprietary technology to improve care quality and affordability.

products.name: Clover Assistant Platform (Physician Enablement Software)
products.description: A proprietary, cloud-based software platform that aggregates and analyzes healthcare data to provide real-time, data-driven clinical decision support and personalized care recommendations to physicians at the point of care. Delivered as a digital solution, it is integrated into provider workflows and EHRs, and is licensed externally as Counterpart Assistant.

products.name: Home-Based Primary Care Services (Clover Home Care)
products.description: A longitudinal, home-based primary care program for high-acuity, medically complex Medicare Advantage members, delivered by clinicians in patients' homes and supported by the Clover Assistant platform to enhance care and outcomes.

products.name: Clinical Care Management Programs
products.description: A suite of targeted clinical programs for high-risk or complex patients, including in-home care management, advanced care planning, care transition support, and behavioral health coordination, delivered by employed clinicians or vendors and powered by the Clover Assistant platform.

products.name: Counterpart Health SaaS & Tech-Enabled Services
products.description: A Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) and tech-enabled services offering, delivered through the Counterpart Health subsidiary, that licenses the Clover Assistant platform and related care management technology to external payors and providers serving the Medicare-eligible population, enabling them to improve patient outcomes and reduce costs.

products.name: INTERCEPT Blood System for Platelets
products.description: A pathogen reduction system for platelets, using proprietary amotosalen compound and UVA light, delivered via disposable kits and an illumination device. Manufactured using physical kits and reagents, and sold to blood centers and hospitals for ex vivo treatment of platelet components for transfusion.

products.name: INTERCEPT Blood System for Plasma
products.description: A system for pathogen reduction in plasma, using amotosalen and UVA light, delivered via disposable kits and an illumination device. Manufactured as a physical product and sold to blood centers and hospitals for ex vivo treatment of plasma for transfusion.

products.name: INTERCEPT Blood System for Cryoprecipitation (including INTERCEPT Fibrinogen Complex and Pathogen Reduced Plasma, Cryoprecipitate Reduced)
products.description: A system and associated kits for producing INTERCEPT Fibrinogen Complex (IFC) and pathogen reduced plasma, cryoprecipitate reduced, from plasma using the INTERCEPT Blood System. Delivered as kits to blood centers or as finished IFC product to hospitals; requires physical manufacturing and regulatory compliance.

products.name: INTERCEPT Blood System for Red Blood Cells
products.description: A system in development for pathogen reduction in red blood cells, using proprietary amustaline compound and a pH-triggered process, delivered via disposable kits. Not yet commercialized; requires physical manufacturing and regulatory approval.

products.name: INTERCEPT Illuminator Devices (UVA and LED-based)
products.description: Illumination devices (UVA and LED-based) used as part of the INTERCEPT Blood System to activate the pathogen reduction process in blood components. Manufactured as physical medical devices and sold to blood centers and hospitals for use with INTERCEPT disposable kits.

products.name: Aluminum Beverage Containers
products.description: Manufactured aluminum cans and ends for carbonated soft drinks, beer, energy drinks, and other beverages, produced in large-scale, capital-intensive facilities operating continuously across North America, EMEA, South America, and select other regions.

products.name: Extruded Aluminum Aerosol Containers
products.description: Manufactured extruded aluminum containers for aerosol products, produced in specialized facilities and sold to personal and home care product companies globally.

products.name: Recloseable Aluminum Bottles
products.description: Manufactured recloseable aluminum bottles for multiple consumer categories, produced in dedicated facilities and supplied to beverage, personal care, and household product companies.

products.name: Aluminum Slugs
products.description: Manufactured aluminum slugs, which are intermediate products used in the production of aerosol containers and bottles, supplied to external customers in the packaging industry.

products.name: Aircraft Parts Supply and Distribution
products.description: Sales and leasing of used serviceable material (USM) and aftermarket distribution of new, OEM-supplied replacement parts for commercial and government aircraft. Involves sourcing, disassembly, repair, and electronic fulfillment via digital platforms. Requires global logistics, technical sales, and partnerships with OEMs.

products.name: Airframe and Component Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul (MRO) Services
products.description: Provision of airframe maintenance, component repair, major inspections, modifications, painting, refurbishment, and engineering services for commercial and military aircraft. Delivered through a network of certified repair stations and facilities, requiring skilled labor and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Fleet Management and Aircraft Operations Services
products.description: Management and operation of customer-owned aircraft fleets, including maintenance and flight operations, primarily for government agencies. Delivered as performance-based contracts requiring operational expertise and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Aviation Supply Chain Logistics and Performance-Based Programs
products.description: Customized supply chain logistics, material planning, sourcing, inventory management, and performance-based logistics programs for commercial airlines and government customers. Involves program management, warranty claim management, and outsourcing of parts and component repair.

products.name: Aviation Maintenance Software Solutions (Trax)
products.description: Provision of cloud-based enterprise resource planning and mobility software for the MRO industry, automating maintenance workflows and regulatory recordkeeping for airlines and MROs. Delivered digitally as SaaS with AI-driven features.

products.name: Expeditionary Mobility Products and Services
products.description: Design, manufacture, and repair of transportation pallets, containers, and shelters for military and humanitarian deployment. Includes engineering and integration of specialized command and control systems. Requires physical manufacturing and engineering expertise.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides commercial and industrial loans, as well as commercial real estate loans, to businesses. These loans are originated and serviced through in-person banking operations and require significant regulatory compliance and risk management.

products.name: Retail Lending
products.description: Offers residential real estate loans (including 1-4 family mortgages) and consumer loans to individuals. These are delivered through branch banking and require underwriting, regulatory compliance, and servicing infrastructure.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Accepts demand, savings, and time deposits from individuals and businesses. These services are provided through physical branches and digital channels, and require regulated deposit insurance and account management systems.

products.name: Water Utility Services
products.description: Provision of potable water to residential, commercial, and industrial customers through regulated utilities. Water is sourced primarily from groundwater, treated to meet potable standards, and distributed via an extensive infrastructure network. Requires significant physical infrastructure, regulatory compliance, and ongoing capital investment.

products.name: Wastewater Utility Services
products.description: Collection, treatment, and safe disposal of wastewater from residential, commercial, and industrial customers. Utilizes decentralized treatment facilities and advanced technology to ensure compliance with environmental regulations. Involves regulated infrastructure and significant capital investment.

products.name: Recycled Water Utility Services
products.description: Production and distribution of highly treated, non-potable recycled water for irrigation, industrial, and other beneficial uses. Employs advanced tertiary treatment and a separate 'purple pipe' distribution system. Requires specialized infrastructure and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Non-Potable Irrigation Water Services
products.description: Provision of non-potable water specifically for irrigation purposes to residential and commercial customers. Delivered through dedicated infrastructure and regulated as a utility service.

products.name: Crude Oil Production and Sales
products.description: Empire Petroleum produces crude oil from operated and non-operated wells in multiple U.S. basins. Oil is extracted from developed fields, then sold at the lease location to third-party purchasers via truck or pipeline under market-based contracts. The company does not refine or transport oil beyond the lease point.

products.name: Natural Gas Production and Sales
products.description: Empire Petroleum extracts natural gas as a byproduct of oil production from its wells. The natural gas is sold at the lease location to third-party purchasers under market-based contracts. The company does not process or transport the gas beyond the lease point.

products.name: Natural Gas Liquids (NGLs) Production and Sales
products.description: Empire Petroleum produces natural gas liquids (NGLs) alongside oil and gas from its wells. NGLs are sold at the lease location to third-party purchasers under market-based contracts. The company does not process or transport NGLs beyond the lease point.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides loans and lines of credit to businesses, including commercial real estate loans, construction loans, and working capital financing. These are delivered through in-person relationship banking and require significant financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Offers loans to individual consumers, including personal loans, residential mortgages, and credit cards. These products are delivered through branch networks and digital channels, requiring regulatory compliance and risk management.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Accepts deposits from commercial and consumer customers, including checking, savings, and money market accounts. Delivered through physical branches and digital platforms, requiring regulated infrastructure and FDIC insurance.

products.name: Cash Management and Payment Solutions
products.description: Provides cash management services, including payments solutions and card services, to business clients. These services are delivered via digital platforms and require integration with payment networks and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Capital Markets and Treasury Services
products.description: Offers capital markets services such as loan syndications, letters of credit, and treasury management to commercial clients. These services require specialized financial expertise and regulatory oversight.

products.name: Foreign Exchange and International Trade Finance
products.description: Provides foreign exchange management and international trade finance services to businesses engaged in cross-border transactions. Delivered through specialized teams and digital platforms, requiring regulatory compliance.

products.name: Wealth Management Services
products.description: Delivers comprehensive wealth management, including financial planning, trust and fiduciary services, investment management and advisory, brokerage, private banking, and business transition planning. Services are provided through dedicated advisors and digital tools, requiring regulatory licensing and oversight.

products.name: Hotel Franchising Services
products.description: Licensing of hotel brands and trademarks to franchisees, providing brand standards, marketing, reservation systems, and operational support. Delivered through long-term franchise agreements with hotel owners, requiring limited capital investment by the company (asset-light model).

products.name: Hotel Management Services (International Full-Service Managed Business)
products.description: Management of select international full-service hotels, providing operational oversight, staffing, and brand standards on behalf of property owners. This is a smaller, primarily international business segment integrated into the franchising segment.

products.name: Guest Loyalty Program (Wyndham Rewards)
products.description: A global guest loyalty program offering points for stays at participating hotels, vacation club resorts, and vacation rentals, redeemable for free nights, merchandise, and experiences. Delivered digitally and funded by contributions from franchisees based on eligible revenues.

products.name: Co-branded Credit Card Offerings
products.description: Co-branded credit card products in partnership with financial institutions, providing cardholders with rewards and benefits tied to Wyndham's loyalty program. Delivered through strategic partnerships and marketed to guests and loyalty members.

products.name: Strategic Licensing Partnerships and Affiliations
products.description: Licensing partnerships and affiliations with third parties, such as Travel + Leisure Co., to extend brand reach and generate ancillary revenue streams. Delivered through contractual agreements with external partners.

products.name: Vertical Application Software Solutions
products.description: Cloud-based and on-premise software platforms, often delivered as SaaS, providing workflow, analytics, compliance, and management solutions for niche industries such as legal, healthcare, education, insurance, government contracting, and professional services. These solutions are developed and maintained by specialized business units and often include AI-enabled features and integrated payment processing.

products.name: Network Software and Electronic Marketplaces
products.description: Cloud-based network software platforms and electronic marketplaces that connect industry participants (e.g., construction, freight, food supply, healthcare, insurance) to automate transactions, data exchange, analytics, and collaboration. These platforms are delivered digitally and often include AI-enabled analytics and workflow automation.

products.name: Technology Enabled Medical Devices and Accessories
products.description: Manufactured medical devices and accessories, including ultrasound guidance and infection control products, airway management devices, surgical scrub and linen dispensing equipment, and precision measurement systems for healthcare providers. These products require regulated manufacturing and are distributed to healthcare facilities globally.

products.name: Precision Fluid Control and Measurement Products
products.description: Manufactured products such as dispensers, metering pumps, water meters, and optical/electromagnetic measurement systems used in industrial, utility, and medical applications. These products are physically produced and often integrated with digital monitoring and management software.

products.name: Wireless Sensor Networks and Access Management Solutions
products.description: Manufactured wireless sensor networks, RFID card readers, and related solutions for life-safety, access management, and identity verification across healthcare, commercial, and industrial environments. These products combine hardware manufacturing with embedded software.

products.name: Sandbox Survival Video Games (ARK Franchise)
products.description: Development and publishing of premium sandbox survival games under the ARK franchise, including ARK: Survival Evolved, ARK: Survival Ascended, and ARK Ultimate Mobile Edition, delivered digitally for consoles, PC, and mobile platforms. These games are developed using advanced game engines and proprietary technology, and are distributed globally via digital storefronts and retail channels.

products.name: Downloadable Content (DLC) and Expansion Packs
products.description: Creation and sale of downloadable content and expansion packs for existing games, primarily for the ARK franchise, providing new maps, missions, and gameplay features. DLCs are digitally delivered and monetized as add-ons to base games across platforms.

products.name: Indie and Third-Party Video Game Publishing
products.description: Publishing and distribution of indie and third-party developed games across various genres and graphical qualities, under labels such as Wandering Wizard and Interactive Films, leveraging proprietary technology and distribution strategies. These games are delivered digitally for PC and consoles.

products.name: Micro-Influencer Marketing Platform (NOIZ)
products.description: Operation of NOIZ, a proprietary digital platform that connects brands and game companies with micro- and macro-influencers for marketing campaigns, providing managed and self-service options, campaign analytics, and eCommerce revenue opportunities. The platform is delivered as a digital service to external clients in the gaming and broader entertainment industries.

products.name: Film, TV, and Digital Media Content
products.description: Production and distribution of short-form film dramas and interactive full-motion video games, including content released via the SaltyTV mobile app and partnerships for global distribution. Content is produced in-house or via partnerships and delivered digitally to consumers.

products.name: Digital Asset and Stablecoin Initiatives
products.description: Development and potential launch of a proprietary stablecoin designed to enable secured digital payments across the company's entertainment ecosystem. This initiative is in early stages and aims to support digital transactions for games and media products.

products.name: KIMMTRAK (tebentafusp)
products.description: A bispecific, soluble TCR-based immunotherapy manufactured at third-party facilities, used for the treatment of unresectable or metastatic uveal melanoma and being evaluated for other melanoma indications. Delivered as an off-the-shelf biologic requiring regulated manufacturing and distribution.

products.name: ImmTAC Oncology Therapeutics
products.description: A portfolio of off-the-shelf, bispecific TCR-based immunotherapies (including brenetafusp, IMC-P115C, IMC-R117C) for various solid tumors such as melanoma, ovarian, lung, and colorectal cancers. These are manufactured biologics delivered via injection or infusion, requiring clinical development and regulated distribution.

products.name: ImmTAV Infectious Disease Therapeutics
products.description: A pipeline of bispecific, soluble TCR-based immunotherapies (including IMC-M113V for HIV and IMC-I109V for HBV) designed to functionally cure or treat infectious diseases. These are biologic drugs produced via advanced bioengineering and delivered to patients under clinical protocols.

products.name: ImmTAAI Autoimmune Disease Therapeutics
products.description: A pipeline of bispecific, soluble TCR-based immunotherapies (including IMC-S118AI for type 1 diabetes and IMC-U120AI for atopic dermatitis) designed to downmodulate immune responses in autoimmune diseases. These are biologic drugs manufactured using proprietary technology and delivered to patients in clinical settings.

products.name: Solid Waste Collection Services
products.description: Collection of non-hazardous waste from residential, commercial, municipal, industrial, and oil & gas (E&P) customers, using a fleet of trucks and containers, under various contract types. Services are delivered through in-person labor and regulated vehicle operations.

products.name: Landfill Disposal Services
products.description: Operation and ownership of municipal solid waste (MSW), E&P waste, and non-MSW landfills for the disposal of collected waste. Requires physical infrastructure, regulatory permits, and ongoing environmental management.

products.name: Transfer Station Services
products.description: Operation of transfer stations that receive, compact, and load waste for transportation to landfills or treatment facilities by truck, rail, or barge. Involves physical facilities and logistics management.

products.name: Recycling Services
products.description: Collection, processing, and marketing of recyclable materials (e.g., paper, cardboard, plastics, metals, glass, compost) from residential, commercial, industrial, and municipal customers. Involves physical sorting facilities and commodity sales.

products.name: Beneficial Reuse of Landfill Gas and Renewable Fuels Generation
products.description: Development, ownership, and operation of landfill gas recovery systems to collect methane and convert it into electricity or pipeline-quality natural gas, which is sold to utilities or gas companies. Requires specialized infrastructure and regulatory compliance.

products.name: E&P Waste Treatment, Recovery and Disposal Services
products.description: Treatment, recovery, and disposal of non-hazardous waste generated by oil and natural gas exploration and production, including fluids, cuttings, and contaminated soils. Delivered through specialized facilities, landfills, caverns, and injection wells, under strict regulatory oversight.

products.name: Intermodal Services for Cargo and Solid Waste Containers
products.description: Provision of intermodal logistics services for the movement of cargo and solid waste containers, particularly in the Pacific Northwest, using rail and other transport modes. Involves coordination of regulated transportation infrastructure.

products.name: Tafenoquine-based Therapies (Arakoda/Kodatef) for Malaria Prevention
products.description: Oral small molecule pharmaceutical (tafenoquine) manufactured synthetically and delivered as a tablet regimen for the prevention of malaria in adults, requiring regulatory approval and G6PD testing prior to administration. Distributed through commercial supply chains in the U.S. (Arakoda) and Australia (Kodatef).

products.name: Tafenoquine-based Therapies for Babesiosis (Acute and Chronic)
products.description: Oral tafenoquine regimen (same or higher dose as Arakoda) developed for treatment of acute and chronic babesiosis (tick-borne disease) in humans, delivered as a tablet and requiring clinical trials and regulatory approval for new indications. Includes both monotherapy and combination therapy with standard of care drugs.

products.name: Tafenoquine-based Therapies for Tick-Borne Disease Prophylaxis
products.description: Oral tafenoquine regimen under development for post-exposure prophylaxis of tick-borne diseases (e.g., babesiosis, Lyme disease) in humans, delivered as a tablet, requiring regulatory approval for this indication.

products.name: Tafenoquine-based Therapies for Veterinary Use (Zamvio)
products.description: Oral tafenoquine regimen (tradename Zamvio) developed for treatment of babesiosis and related tick-borne diseases in animals (primarily dogs, potentially horses), manufactured synthetically and delivered as a tablet, with pilot studies conducted and regulatory submissions planned for veterinary approval.

products.name: Celgosivir-based Antiviral Therapies
products.description: Small molecule pharmaceutical (celgosivir), a host-targeted glucosidase inhibitor synthesized from castanospermine, developed for the treatment and prevention of viral diseases such as Dengue, RSV, and potentially COVID-19 and Zika. Requires chemical synthesis, clinical trials, and regulatory approval.

products.name: Australian Chestnut Extract (Castanoboost)
products.description: Botanical extract capsule derived from the seeds of the Australian Chestnut Tree (Castanospermum australe), containing castanospermine, intended for use as a dietary supplement with antiviral, metabolic, and immunomodulatory properties. Manufactured via extraction and planned for commercialization as a non-prescription product.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Lending
products.description: Origination and servicing of fixed- and adjustable-rate one- to four-family residential mortgage loans, primarily through in-house originations and purchases from mortgage brokers. Loans are secured by residential real estate and require physical underwriting, appraisals, and compliance with regulatory standards.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending
products.description: Origination of adjustable-rate and fixed-rate loans secured by commercial real estate properties, including office buildings, industrial facilities, and retail properties. Loans are physically underwritten, require appraisals, and are subject to regulatory and internal credit standards.

products.name: Multi-Family Real Estate Lending
products.description: Origination of adjustable-rate loans secured by multi-family properties (five or more rental units), with underwriting based on property income, appraisals, and borrower qualifications. Loans are physically originated and serviced.

products.name: Commercial and Industrial Lending
products.description: Origination of secured and unsecured loans and lines of credit to small- and medium-sized businesses, including SBA loans for working capital, equipment, and real estate. Loans require financial analysis, collateral, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Provision of home equity loans and lines of credit, unsecured personal loans, rehabilitation loans, and loans secured by deposit accounts. These loans are underwritten based on borrower creditworthiness and collateral where applicable.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Offering a range of deposit accounts to individuals and businesses, including noninterest-bearing and interest-bearing checking, savings, money market accounts, and certificates of deposit. Services are delivered through physical branches and online banking.

products.name: Residential and Commercial Flow Control and Protection Products
products.description: Products and solutions for plumbing and hot water applications, including backflow preventers, water pressure regulators, temperature and pressure relief valves, thermostatic mixing valves, leak detection and protection products, commercial washroom solutions, hydration solutions, and emergency safety equipment. These are manufactured using metal and plastic components and increasingly feature smart, connected technology for monitoring and control.

products.name: Heating, Ventilation, Air Conditioning (HVAC) and Gas Products
products.description: Commercial, institutional, and industrial high-efficiency boilers, water heaters, hydronic and electric heating systems for under-floor radiant applications, custom heat and hot water solutions, hydronic pump groups, alternative energy control packages, and flexible stainless steel gas connectors. These products are manufactured with advanced controls and are designed for integration with building management systems.

products.name: Drainage and Water Re-use Products
products.description: Drainage products and engineered rainwater harvesting solutions for commercial, industrial, marine, and residential applications, including connected roof drain systems. These are physically manufactured products designed for water management and sustainability.

products.name: Water Quality Products and Solutions
products.description: Point-of-use, point-of-entry, closed loop, cooling tower, and other water applications for water filtration, monitoring, conditioning, and scale prevention systems. These are manufactured systems and devices for commercial, marine, light industrial, and residential use, often incorporating advanced filtration and monitoring technology.

products.name: Smart and Connected Water Management Solutions (Nexa Platform)
products.description: Intelligent water management solutions for buildings that integrate sensing technologies, smart and connected equipment, and cloud-based software (SaaS) to provide actionable visibility, operational oversight, water risk management, and sustainability support. Delivered as a combination of hardware and digital services.
